page.overview:
Who is Kuai Liang?

As Sub-Zero: Ice Scepter (MK4, MKG) Kori Blade (MK:DA, MK:D, MK:U, MK:A, MKvsDCU, MK 2011, MKX, MK11) Cybernetic Weapons (MK 2011)Ice Daggers (MKX, MK11) Ice Hammer (MKX) Ice Pollaxe (MK11)

As Sub-Zero: Shotokan (MK:DA, MK:D, MK:U, MK:A, MKvsDCU, MK 2011, MKX, MK11)Dragon (MK:DA, MK:D, MK:U, MKvsDCU, MK 2011, MKX, MK11) Ninjitsu (MK 2011, MKX, MK11)

Kuai Liang (Chinese: 奎良), once known as Sub-Zero (Chinese: 绝对零度; Absolute Zero), Grandmaster (of the Lin Kuei), Tundra, and briefly as the cyborg LK-52O is a character in the Mortal Kombat fighting game series.

Kuai Liang made his playable debut in Mortal Kombat II as a Lin Kuei assassin and the younger brother of Bi-Han, who was the original Sub-Zero in the original Mortal Kombat arcade game. He takes the mantle of Sub-Zero in his later appearances in the series but reappears under his original alias of Tundra in Mortal Kombat (2011) before again going under the mantle of Sub-Zero.
